author: Claude
scale: Scale C (SCORING.md on origin/main, D proportional revision 2026-11-27)
sources: agent/terms-archive captures of 25 Nov 2026 + owner uploads; official help-centre snippets where stated
note: Research proposal only. No score file changed. Point deltas are per criterion; the final score must be recomputed by the builder (contract cap 30, consistency+D cap 15).

decided.quote: if the Client acts in a manner that may damage the Company's good reputation [...] restrict access to all or only some services without any prior notice and without any compensation
decided.why: Not limited to false statements; the sanction is restriction of access without compensation, and §8.11 removes rewards on any breach of the T&C.

decided.quote: otherwise engages in conduct or activities that, in ETF’s sole discretion creates, reputational, regulatory, or financial risk to ETF
decided.why: Same scope as MyFundedFutures §16.1.3, which the owner kept at −5; maintained for consistency. Generic, not limited to false statements.

decided.quote: or act in a manner that may damage our reputation, including after termination of the Agreement, we will terminate one or more Agreements and you will lose access to the Services
decided.why: Mandatory termination without compensation (§14.2), not limited to false statements; same template as FTMO cl. 11.1.

decided.quote: including support messages, Client Area notifications, email correspondence, and decisions on your account – are confidential and may not be published
decided.why: §16.2 expressly exempts truthful statements and genuine reviews and does not ground the penalty. §16.1 does: publishing an account decision such as a payout refusal is sanctionable under §16.3 (withholding of undetermined Rewards, termination and permanent ban). The penalty text must be rewritten.

decided.article: Terms of Use — Termination for Cause
decided.quote: You make any defamatory, disparaging, or harmful statements about the Company, its employees, or the Services on any public platform
decided.why: 'Disparaging' covers honest criticism; the same clause states that accrued profits or Reward Balance are immediately forfeited.

decided.quote: Making derogatory or offensive statements about our company, employees, or affiliates
decided.why: §5.3 alone (false, misleading or defamatory) would not qualify. The 'Defamatory Content' section also covers 'false or damaging information' and 'derogatory' statements: the contract is terminated immediately and all profits forfeited.

decided.quote: governed pursuant to separate or supplemental written agreement
decided.why: Only establishes that a separate agreement exists. No official text says the agreement is unavailable before purchase, and funded rules are published in the help centre. Under the owner's policy this is not proof (reinstate if a written statement or a refusal of pre-purchase access is documented).

decided.quote: The specific rules of the Master Account will be communicated to the Client via a separate agreement and/or email notification from the Platform’s Risk Department
decided.why: §13.3 says Master Account conditions are set 'based on the Client’s trading behavior and performance during the evaluation phase' and may change leverage, risk per trade and margin. The funded terms therefore do not exist before purchase.

decided.quote: Funded Trader Agreement — provided at the point of transition to the Funded Trader Phase or, for Hyro Instant, during setup before the account is Issued
decided.why: Explicit written statement. §6.4: that agreement governs 'the performance-reward mechanism, payout schedule, additional trading rules'. For Hyro Instant it is provided after the non-refundable Instant Fee is paid.

decided.quote: To accept the offer, you must sign a separate Funded Trader Agreement that the Company will provide you.
decided.why: The agreement is provided with the offer that follows the evaluation (§3.7), and the profit split arises only under it. Medium confidence: the help centre could not be read to exclude a published template.

decided.quote: (archive bloquée, 267 caractères : texte non relisible)
decided.why: Current basis: 'whose text is not published'. Non-publication alone is not proof, and the terms could not be re-read to find a written statement on timing.

decided.quote: we submit your results to our funding partners, and upon approval, you will receive and complete the trading contract and other documents required by our funding partners
decided.why: Written statement that the contract is received after approval, issued by a funding partner who is not identified before purchase. Published funded rules do not replace the contract.

decided.quote: Once you sign the POA form and your PRO trader contract, your PRO account will get created.
decided.why: Establishes signature at activation, not that the contract is unavailable before purchase. The cited article (PRO Account Rules) could not be re-read (Zendesk blocked in the archive) and the PRO rules are published. Reinstate if a written statement is documented.

decided.quote: If you are accepted as a Professional User, the legal relationship between You and the Company will be governed by additional terms, which you will be required to accept in addition to these Terms.
decided.why: Only a separate agreement. The Professional stage (payouts every 14 days, $300 minimum, parameters) is published in the Program Terms (tradethepool.com/program-terms/, archived).

decided.quote: are governed by a separate agreement between the User and TradeDay
decided.why: No text on when the agreement becomes available. Funded Sim and Funded Live rules are published in the help centre (Freshdesk). Not proof under the owner's policy.

decided.article: Sim Funded Accounts Rules §4–5 ; Live Brokerage (effective 1 Oct 2026)
decided.quote: Eligible Sim Funded profits are placed into your Bonus Vault instead of becoming your live starting balance
decided.why: Live starts at $0; sim profits go to a Bonus Vault 'paid according to the applicable Bonus Vault rules', which are not published in the article; the alternative is a buyout of 50% of the drawdown; the risk team can close the sim account at review. Preservation of all accrued gains is not shown, so the zero-cost exception does not apply.

decided.article: E8 Signature ; Payout caps and buffers for E8 Signature
decided.quote: $2,000 EOD - $50,000 account
decided.why: Official formula: first capped withdrawal on 50K = $1,250 / initial funded loss budget $2,000 EOD (https://intercom.help/e8/en/articles/11755943-e8-signature) = 0.625, which costs 2 points. The '5 payouts then closure' limit reported elsewhere is not confirmed on an official page: review item, not counted.

decided.quote: ETF reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to convert a Trader to a LIVE ELITE Account at any time, before, during, or after a Reward request.
decided.why: Archived terms (25 Nov): transition considered after one Reward, 5 active days or $1,000; pending Rewards can be applied to the LIVE ELITE allocation or the Vault instead of being paid. The 80/20 figure comes from /elite, which was not re-read. The $25,000 threshold in the current text contradicts the terms: rewrite.

decided.quote: Withdrawal requests of profits will be processed on demand, but can be requested no more than once every 30 days.
decided.why: The agreement, still published, sets a 30-day minimum interval, while the programme page states 'First payout on demand' from the first funded day (https://fxify.com/fast-payouts/). This is a contradiction between two concurrently published documents (B4) rather than a proven payment window applicable to the current programme. Net unchanged (3 points); classification to confirm.

decided.quote: the maximum payout amount per fourteen (14) calendar day period is USD 10,000
decided.why: Trader stage: total loss 8% of account size (hashhedge.gitbook.io rules). No 50K size; nearest capped sizes are 25K and 100K. 100K: 10,000 / 8,000 = 1.25, which costs 1 point. The 14-day interval is not above 14 days.

decided.quote: which may fall between fourteen (14) and sixty (60) calendar days from the opening of the first trade in that trading cycle
decided.why: The trader chooses the payout day from 14 days onward (standard timing); identity re-verification is reasonable verification (0); suspensions during a Hold are already counted under B2A −4. One fact, one penalty.

decided.quote: The buffer is equal to: Initial Max Loss Limit + $100
decided.why: 50K: required buffer $52,100, so the initial Max Loss Limit is $2,000; maximum first payout $2,000. Ratio 1.0, which costs 1 point. No fixed interval ('There is no fixed payout window'). The 40% consistency rule is scored separately.

decided.quote: Rather than carrying over a capped amount of sim profits as was our previous policy, traders will receive live accounts
decided.why: Live starts at $0 and sim profits are not carried over; refusing the live account means closing the sim account. Accrued gains are not preserved, so the zero-cost exception does not apply.

undecided.reason: The Program Rules and Withdrawal Rules PDFs (axidocs S3) are not in the archive; no re-reading possible.
Same: the cited programme page and PDFs were not re-read.
The 'New live structure' article is not archived (main Lucid site blocked).

The cited swayfunded.kb.help page is not archived and the archived T&C do not mention the 1.5% fee. Provisional view: probable suppression (fee, $10 minimum and closed positions are ordinary conditions) unless the trading freeze goes beyond processing time.
